## Source URL

Link directly to the primary source. Include an archive snapshot if you have verified one.

## Record or claim

Identify the post, response, event listing, or specific statement.

## Suggested change

Describe the addition or correction and provide the relevant publication and check dates.

## Context

Add any context needed to read the source fairly. Separate quoted words from your summary or interpretation.

## Checklist

- [ ] The source is public and directly supports the suggestion.
- [ ] Any quotation is brief and checked against the source.
- [ ] This report contains no private personal information or request to contact an individual.
